name: Strait of Hormuz
description: Critical chokepoint handling ~20% of global oil transit. ~40-45% of India's crude imports transit here.

name: Red Sea
description: Red Sea / Bab-el-Mandeb strait. Key transit route affected by Houthi disruptions since 2023.

name: Iran Exports
description: Direct crude imports from Iran, subject to periodic sanctions pressure.

name: Persian Gulf
description: Broader Persian Gulf shipping lanes. Saudi Arabia, Iraq, Kuwait, and UAE exports to India.

name: Suez Canal
description: Egypt's Suez Canal — key shortcut for Europe-Asia oil trade, alternative routing for Indian imports.

name: Cape of Good Hope
description: Alternative long-haul route around Africa when Red Sea/Suez routes are disrupted. Higher transit costs.
